ns2:course.label: Renewable Energy Systems
ns2:course.description: Renewable energy sources and applications, including solar, geothermal, wind, and biomass. Examines how renewable energy can reduce air pollution and global climate change. Includes a capstone project to design a system for converting renewable energy into thermal or electrical energy. Same as TSM 436. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PHYS 211.
